name: get_patient_summary
description: Get a comprehensive patient summary including demographics, active conditions (ICD-10 coded), current medications, allergies, recent visits, and last recorded vitals. Access is audit-logged per HIPAA.

name: search_medical_records
description: Search a patient's medical records by keyword, condition, or clinical term. Full-text search across clinical notes, labs, imaging reports, procedures, referrals, and discharge summaries, sorted by relevance.

query.description: Search keyword or clinical term (e.g., 'diabetes', 'chest pain', 'MRI', 'hemoglobin')

name: get_medication_list
description: Get the current medication reconciliation for a patient with dosage, frequency, route, drug class, indication, prescriber, pharmacy, refill status, and adherence rate. Flags refills needed and polypharmacy.

name: get_lab_results
description: Get recent lab results for a patient with reference ranges and HIGH/LOW/BORDERLINE flags. Covers metabolic panel, CBC, lipid panel, HbA1c, and thyroid panel. Highlights critical values requiring provider notification.

days.description: Number of days to look back for lab results, e.g. 30, 90, 365 (Default: 90)
